'''Shield boosters''' were auxiliary [[Starship/Legends|starship]] devices that provided boost the ship's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. The company [[BvK Fleet Systems]] manufactured the [[GalaxyGuard Mk. VII]] shield boosters.
